name: Billbee Order Management
description: Manage orders, products, customers, stock and shipments in Billbee, the leading German/DACH multichannel order-management (Warenwirtschaft) platform used by 20,000+ online retailers: read orders and articles, change order states, add tracking numbers, create labels and invoices, and update stock.
instructions:
Billbee is the leading German/DACH multichannel order-management tool (20,000+ retailers) connecting marketplaces and shops (Amazon, eBay, Otto, Kaufland, Shopify, WooCommerce, etc.). This connector wraps the REST API at https://api.billbee.io/api/v1.

## Authentication (THREE credentials, all required)
Billbee requires both an application API key AND HTTP Basic Auth at the same time:
1. `BILLBEE_API_KEY` — sent in the `X-Billbee-Api-Key` header. Request it from Billbee (via their API request form / support@billbee.io, describing what you build).
2. `BILLBEE_LOGIN_EMAIL` — your Billbee account login email (Basic Auth username).
3. `BILLBEE_API_PASSWORD` — a dedicated API password (NOT your normal login password). Enable the API and set this password in the Billbee web app under Settings → Billbee API → General Settings.
All three are mandatory; the API key alone or Basic Auth alone will be rejected.

## Pagination
List endpoints use `page` (1-based) and `pageSize` (max 250). Responses wrap rows in a paged envelope: a `Data` array plus a `Paging` object with `Page`, `TotalPages`, `TotalRows`. Iterate `page` until `Page == TotalPages`.

## Orders
`billbee_list_orders` filters by `minOrderDate`/`maxOrderDate` and `modifiedAtMin`/`modifiedAtMax` (incremental sync). Order states are numeric; use `billbee_get_order` for full detail, or `billbee_get_order_by_extref` to look up by the marketplace's external order number.

## Writing
The write tools act on the live account, and Billbee passes most changes on to the connected shops and marketplaces:
- `billbee_set_order_state`: 3 paid, 4 shipped, 8 canceled, 13 packed (full list in the parameter). The shop or marketplace may email the buyer.
- `billbee_add_shipment_to_order` stores a tracking number created elsewhere. `billbee_ship_order_with_label` books a real label with a carrier connected in Billbee (DHL, DPD, GLS...); take `providerId` and `productId` from `billbee_list_shipping_providers`, and ask the user before booking.
- `billbee_update_stock` sets the absolute quantity by SKU; with multi-stock, pass `stockId` from `billbee_list_stocks`.
- `billbee_update_order` and `billbee_update_product` change only the fields passed, with Billbee's PascalCase names.
- `billbee_create_invoice` is limited to one call per order every 5 minutes.
Order ids in paths are Billbee's internal ids (`BillBeeOrderId`), not the shop order number: look those up with `billbee_get_order_by_extref`.

## Rate limit
Hard limit of 2 requests per second per (API key + user); exceeding it returns HTTP 429 — back off and retry. The API has usage-based pricing above a free allotment, so avoid tight polling loops; prefer `modifiedAtMin`/`updatedOrNewSince`-style incremental queries.

tools.name: billbee_list_orders
tools.description: List orders from Billbee with filtering by order date range, modification date (incremental sync) and pagination. Returns a paged envelope of order summaries.

minOrderDate.description: Only orders created on/after this date-time (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-01)

maxOrderDate.description: Only orders created on/before this date-time (ISO 8601)

modifiedAtMin.description: Only orders modified on/after this date-time (ISO 8601) — use for incremental sync

modifiedAtMax.description: Only orders modified on/before this date-time (ISO 8601)

tools.name: billbee_get_order
tools.description: Get a single Billbee order by its internal Billbee order id, returning full detail including line items, addresses, payment and shipping info.

tools.name: billbee_get_order_by_extref
tools.description: Look up a Billbee order by its external reference (the marketplace/shop order number), returning the full order detail.

extRef.description: The external order number / reference from the marketplace or shop

tools.name: billbee_list_products
tools.description: List products/articles from Billbee with pagination. Returns article ids, SKUs, titles, prices and stock fields.

minCreatedAt.description: Only products created on/after this date-time (ISO 8601)

tools.name: billbee_get_product
tools.description: Get a single Billbee product by id (or by SKU/EAN via lookupBy), returning full article detail including pricing and stock.

id.description: The product identifier (Billbee article id by default)

tools.name: billbee_list_customers
tools.description: List customers from Billbee with pagination. Returns customer ids, names, contact details and addresses.

tools.name: billbee_get_customer_orders
tools.description: List all orders belonging to a specific Billbee customer by customer id, with pagination. Useful for customer history and support lookups.

tools.name: billbee_list_shipping_providers
tools.description: List the shipping providers configured in the Billbee account, returning provider names and their available shipping products.

tools.name: billbee_list_stocks
tools.description: List the stock locations (Lager) defined in the Billbee account, with their ids. Needed for billbee_update_stock when the multi-stock feature is on.

tools.name: billbee_set_order_state
tools.description: Change the main state of one order, e.g. to paid (3) or shipped (4). Billbee passes the new state on to the shop or marketplace if that is configured, so the buyer may be notified.

id.description: The internal Billbee order id (BillBeeOrderId from billbee_list_orders or billbee_get_order, not the shop order number)

newStateId.description: New state: 1 ordered, 2 confirmed, 3 paid, 4 shipped, 5 reclamation, 6 deleted, 7 closed, 8 canceled, 9 archived, 11 demand note 1, 12 demand note 2, 13 packed, 14 offered, 15 payment reminder, 16 fulfilling

tools.name: billbee_add_shipment_to_order
tools.description: Attach a shipment you already created elsewhere (a tracking number from DHL, DPD, a carrier portal...) to an order. It does not create a label and does not change the order state; use billbee_set_order_state for that.

id.description: The internal Billbee order id (BillBeeOrderId from billbee_list_orders or billbee_get_order, not the shop order number)

shippingProviderId.description: Id of a shipping provider in this Billbee account, from billbee_list_shipping_providers

shippingProviderProductId.description: Id of that provider's product, from billbee_list_shipping_providers

carrierId.description: Id of the carrier, overrides the carrier of the provider

orderNumber.description: A different order number for this shipment, if there is one

tools.name: billbee_ship_order_with_label
tools.description: Create a shipping label for an order through a carrier connected in Billbee (DHL, DPD, GLS, Deutsche Post...), using the account's own carrier contract. Returns the shipment with its tracking number and the label. Each call books a real, billable shipment with the carrier.

productId.description: Shipping product id of that provider, from billbee_list_shipping_providers

changeStateToSend.description: Set the order to shipped after the label is created

weightInGram.description: Parcel weight in grams, overrides the weight Billbee calculates from the articles

shipDate.description: Ship date sent to the carrier (ISO 8601 date)

clientReference.description: Reference text printed on the label (not supported by every carrier)

printerName.description: Name of a cloud printer connected in Billbee to send the label to

tools.name: billbee_update_stock
tools.description: Set the stock quantity of one article, by SKU. The quantity is absolute (the new total), not a change. Billbee sends the new stock on to the connected shops and marketplaces.

billbeeId.description: Billbee product id, if the SKU is not unique

stockId.description: Stock location id from billbee_list_stocks, when multi-stock is on

reason.description: Reason stored with the stock change

autosubtractReservedAmount.description: Subtract the quantity reserved by open orders from newQuantity

forceSendStockToShops.description: Send the stock to the shops even if it did not change

tools.name: billbee_add_order_tags
tools.description: Add tags to an order. Existing tags stay; tags already on the order are ignored, and tags are not case sensitive.

id.description: The internal Billbee order id (BillBeeOrderId from billbee_list_orders or billbee_get_order, not the shop order number)

tools.name: billbee_update_order
tools.description: Change one or more fields of an order. Only the fields you pass change. Use Billbee's field names as billbee_get_order returns them, e.g. {"SellerComment": "Call before delivery"}. For the state use billbee_set_order_state, for tags billbee_add_order_tags.

id.description: The internal Billbee order id (BillBeeOrderId from billbee_list_orders or billbee_get_order, not the shop order number)

fields.description: Fields to change, with Billbee order field names (PascalCase)

tools.name: billbee_update_product
tools.description: Change one or more fields of a product. Only the fields you pass change. Use Billbee's field names as billbee_get_product returns them, e.g. {"Price": 19.9, "Weight": 450}. For stock use billbee_update_stock.

fields.description: Fields to change, with Billbee product field names (PascalCase)

tools.name: billbee_create_invoice
tools.description: Create the invoice for an existing order with the account's invoice template. Billbee allows this at most once per order every 5 minutes. Returns the invoice number and, with includeInvoicePdf, the PDF as base64.

id.description: The internal Billbee order id (BillBeeOrderId from billbee_list_orders or billbee_get_order, not the shop order number)

includeInvoicePdf.description: Include the invoice PDF (base64) in the response

templateId.description: Invoice template id, instead of the one assigned to the order

sendToCloudId.description: Id of a connected cloud printer or cloud storage to send the invoice to
